title: The Reader of Dead Archives
blurb: Digitized rooms of paper nobody had read. Left ten leads and a faint smell of mildew.

title: The Whale-Whisperer
blurb: Pulled the whales, shrimp and ships apart from a single hydrophone. The shrimp were the surprise.

title: The Xenobiologist-at-Large
blurb: Read turtles as magnetometers and fishing fleets as tsunami sensors. Regrets nothing.

title: The Diviner of Couplings
blurb: Coupled things that should not talk to each other. A few of them talked back.

title: The Weather Necromancer
blurb: Read an un-transcribed 1885 keeper's log with AI; 122 days of temperature that predate the town's official record by a decade, confirmed against reanalysis.
